description: This file contains utility functions for database interactions, including checking UTF-8 support, retrieving database character set, and constructing count queries from SQL statements within a SugarCRM-based project.

methods.name: check_db_utf8_support
methods.description: Checks if the database supports UTF-8 encoding by examining database variables for character set and collation.

methods.name: get_db_charset
methods.description: Retrieves the character set of the database, defaulting to 'UTF8' for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: mkCountQuery
methods.description: Generates a COUNT(*) SQL query from a provided SELECT query, removing ORDER BY and GROUP BY clauses.
